messages:
maya: quick flag for the weekly KPI readout tomorrow  the launch-posts spike shows 402 in our dashboard but downstream systems are lower. want to align before the deck :mag:
oliver: which downstream numbers? hubspot, sfdc, or revops exports
nick (revops): hubspot currently lists 283 with utm_campaign=launch-q2, sfdc pipeline shows 270. looks like attribution + routing differences
sam: the dashboard uses a 14d first-touch window. hubspot is last-touch 7d by default. that alone explains a chunk of the variance
frank (sales): sales sees ~265 qualified records for that week. a few were fast-routed to enterprise queue which removes them from the standard funnel view
maya: suggested readout: show three metrics side-by-side: dashboard raw (first-touch 14d), deduped distinct contacts (email), and HS-tagged (last-touch 7d). we should also surface quality: conv->mql and top-10 domains
nick (revops): i'll run a quick dedupe and export top domains. sql i'm running:
```sql
select count(distinct email) as unique_contacts, domain(extract(email)) as domain
from events.leads
where received_at >= '2026-03-08' and received_at < '2026-03-15'
and utm_campaign = 'launch-q2'
group by domain
order by unique_contacts desc
limit 10;
```
results in ~6m, will post shortly
oliver: i'll add a tiny footnote in the dashboard: "First-touch (14d) default. Toggle to Last-touch (7d). Differences may be caused by marketing automation routing."
sam: i'll create a small pivot that splits cohort into: launch-only, launch->webinar, webinar-only. helps show overlap vs unique lift
frank (sales): can marketing also add MQL->SQL velocity (median days) in the one-pager? leadership asks about lead quality, not just volume
maya: yes  add conv->mql % and median time-to-mql. include a note if enterprise-routing removed any >$50k ARR leads from the standard funnel
dashbot: weekly-kpi-summary: dash_launch=402, deduped_unique=361, hubspot_tagged=283, sfdc_pipeline=270, webinar_signups=95
nick (revops): dedupe results: unique_contacts for "launch-q2" = 361 distinct emails. top domains: redwood.com (54), gmail.com (120), yahoo.com (12), startupco.com (8), edu domains combined (6)
maya: perfect. for tomorrow we'll present: raw dash=402, deduped distinct=361, HS-tagged=283, quality signals: conv->mql=18%, median time-to-mql=3.2 days, top enterprise leads flagged. meet TOM 9:00 to finalise the one-pager :rocket:
